name: FILEN-030: a password reset without the recovery key keeps the old encrypted data, never deletes it
description: FILEN-030 (Filen): anyone with the e-mail inbox could reset the password without the master/recovery key and wipe the whole zero-knowledge account at once. Rules I1, D5 (no login path removes a file); the account side is crypto-keys-and-recovery (pending: the recovery flow).
pending: an account's plan, usage, subscription and password reset are the token server's (azctl test money, sync-chaos srv-account-never-deleted); the stand-in remote has no account (MISS25-A): drive_account / drive_account_reset need a stand-in token server in the E2E harness
